automatic_rejects: episode has fewer than one observation record
episode has no state_after or state update
verifier transition lacks command/test output or explicit blocked reason
patch-generation projection requested for no_patch or missing patch_trace episode
source path is dependency cache or build artifact
candidate action set is missing or has fewer than 5 actions for decision training
hard negatives are implausible or all same role
one-span harness metadata is promoted above level_1 without ordered commands/observations
Open-SWE/commit context is promoted above level_2 without command output
selected-test smoke is promoted above level_1 without patch or state sequence
training_policy: No trainer request may be emitted unless Stage12190 output is re-audited by this gate and meets minimum_for_any_diagnostic_training. Frontier training requires minimum_for_frontier_training.
